answer: Coordination-Priced Admission Queue. Each joining agent pays a queue price set by the current number of pending joiners: price rises with arrival rate, so mass registration self-inflates cost. A knoll of withheld admissions is held until the cohort's arrival intervals are verified. Each verification round draws a saffron receipt tied to live resource consumption, forcing distinct agents to show independent work. A haven of refunds exists only for agents whose intervals diverge naturally. A sybil cohort pays the inflated queue price per identity plus wasted proof work it cannot reclaim.
